meta.source: Neeley planning pack (neeley_programs.json + NEELEY_RULES.md), built 2026-10-17 from official TCU sources
meta.note: Program requirements are from official pages with conflicts flagged in contradictions. Class-standing cutoffs and first-year 'business major' status are labeled historical / unconfirmed.

standing.source: Sophomore 24, junior 54, senior 84 earned hours, from TCU catalogs 2003-04 through 2007-08; the 2019-20 and 2023-24 catalogs' 54-hour declared-major rule fits. Not confirmed for 2026-27, so the registrar should confirm. (historical; confirm for 2026-27)

cohorts.label: Started before summer 2025
cohorts.source: https://www.neeley.tcu.edu/BBA/Graduation-Checklist (conflict: The Neeley Graduation Checklist says 124 hours; the TCU Advising FAQ says 120 for students who began Fall 2021 or later.)

old-foundation.name: Business foundation (pre-2025 rules)
old-foundation.note: BUSI 10153 is on the older checklist and the official suggested four-year plans but is not in the current TCU course export. Students who already completed it are fine; anyone who still needs it should ask an advisor what replaces it.

core-old.name: TCU Core (before summer 2025)
rules: No course fills two Heritage, Mission, Vision & Values categories.
At most 2 courses from one prefix within each group.
Humanities, Social Sciences and Natural Sciences each need at least two different prefixes.
Writing Emphasis can overlap with anything.

new-business-core.name: Business core (16 hours)
new-business-core.note: The Neeley checklists list MANA 30250 + MANA 30350; the new four-year plans pair MANA 30250 with MANA 40250 instead. MANA 30350 is not in the TCU course export, and neither MANA 30250 nor MANA 40250 has a section in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027. What does run is MANA 30253 (OB and Strategy, 3 hours, 22 sections), so the plan uses it. An advisor must confirm it satisfies this requirement.

core-new.name: TCU Core (summer 2025 and later)
rules: A course can count for at most 2 Core categories plus Writing Emphasis.
OCO and WCO courses count only for themselves.
No more than 4 Core requirements (not counting OCO and WCO) from one course prefix.
Writing Emphasis courses must be 30000-40000 level and taken at TCU.

BBA-FINA-r2.name: Finance: Finance electives (6 hours)
BBA-FINA-r2.note: FINA 40970 counts only for topics 'Alternative Asset Investments' and 'Equity Investments Practicum'. FINA 40533 Spring only; FINA 40623 Fall only. The after-summer-2025 checklist also lists FINA 30313 Real Estate Principles (not in catalog list): advisor confirm.

BBA-FINA-r3.name: Finance: Global content

BBA-ACCT-r2.note: Catalog: choose 1.5-3 hours; ACCT 55260 is 1.5 hours. Checklist lists ACCT 50970 'Global Perspective in Accounting' instead of ACCT 55260. FINA 40623 Fall only.

BBA-ACCT-r3.name: Accounting: Accounting ethics (3 hours)
BBA-ACCT-r3.note: Catalog lists ACCT 30450 / ACCT 55450 and ACCT 30460 / ACCT 55460 as alternatives (1.5 hours each). 55000-level requires ACCT 30253 + ACCT 30273.

BBA-ACCT-r4.name: Accounting: Accounting career content (6 hours)

contradictions.title: MANA 30350 is missing
contradictions.text: The new business core lists MANA 30250 + MANA 30350, but MANA 30350 isn't in TCU's course list.
contradictions.source: Neeley checklists vs TCU course export

contradictions.title: MANA 30253 stands in for MANA 30250
contradictions.text: Neither MANA 30250 nor MANA 40250 has a section in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027; MANA 30253 (OB and Strategy, 3 hrs) runs, so the plan uses it. An advisor must confirm it satisfies the business core.
contradictions.source: TCU Class Search 2026-27; Neeley four-year plans

contradictions.title: ACCT 20153 doesn't exist
contradictions.text: MANA 30153 and MANA 30253 list ACCT 20153 as a prerequisite, which isn't in TCU's course list. The plan treats it as ACCT 20353.
contradictions.source: TCU course text vs course export

contradictions.title: BUSI 10153 is no longer listed
contradictions.text: BUSI 10153 is on older checklists but not in TCU's course list, and BUSI 10151 has no sections. Completed is fine; if still needed, an advisor picks the replacement.

contradictions.title: ENTR 20153 has no 2026-27 sections
contradictions.text: ENTR 20153 (old business foundation) has no 2026-27 sections. An advisor approves a substitute, likely ENTR 20263.

contradictions.title: 120 vs. 124 total hours
contradictions.text: TCU's Advising FAQ says 120 hours; the Neeley Graduation Checklist says 124 for older students. The plan uses 120.
contradictions.source: TCU Advising FAQ vs Neeley Graduation Checklist

contradictions.title: Residency hours differ by source
contradictions.text: New checklists say 45 TCU hours / 36 upper-level; the Graduation Checklist says 58 / 42. The plan uses your rulebook's numbers.

contradictions.title: Class-standing cutoffs not confirmed
contradictions.text: The 24 / 54 / 84-hour standing cutoffs come from older catalogs and aren't confirmed for 2026-27.

contradictions.title: First-year 'business major' status unclear
contradictions.text: TCU doesn't say whether first-year business students count as 'business majors' for course gates. The plan uses the earliest-semester rules.

contradictions.title: Accounting major hours conflict
contradictions.text: 21 hrs (program page) vs 31.5-33 (major page) vs 25.5 + 9-12 associated (checklist, with graduate-numbered ACCT 55450/55460).

contradictions.title: Global Business minor hours
contradictions.text: Its parts add to 24 hours but it's published as 18.

contradictions.title: BIS minor elective count unclear
contradictions.text: The page doesn't say how many courses to pick from the final 'OR' block; the plan assumes 2.

contradictions.title: Sustainable Business Certificate incomplete
contradictions.text: Total hours aren't published, so the plan never marks it complete.

contradictions.title: Management major requirement conflict
contradictions.text: The catalog requires MANA 40153; the after-summer-2025 checklist lists MANA 30313 instead and adds MANA 40323 as an elective. The plan uses the catalog list.

contradictions.title: Supply & Value Chain major conflict
contradictions.text: Catalog: 3 required + 12 elective hours; checklist: 8 fixed courses (22 hrs). The plan uses the catalog list.

contradictions.title: Real Estate global-content trap
contradictions.text: Choosing FINA 40623 adds a 1.5-hr ethics course whose versions either need ACCT 30253/30273 or aren't scheduled. The plan steers to BUSI 30383.

contradictions.title: FINA 40970 counts only for two topics
contradictions.text: FINA 40970 counts as a Finance elective only for Alternative Asset Investments and Equity Investments Practicum. Check the section title.

contradictions.title: BIS major has no elective
contradictions.text: The current catalog requires INSC 40383 and allows INSC 30273 for INSC 40843 and INSC 30283 for INSC 30833.

contradictions.title: FINA 30313 is Real Estate only
contradictions.text: FINA 30313 is listed as a Finance elective but restricted to Real Estate concentration students.

contradictions.title: MARK 40033 isn't in the course list
contradictions.text: The Marketing checklist lists MARK 40033; the catalog has MARK 40030. The plan uses MARK 40030.

contradictions.title: Leadership minor has two tracks
contradictions.text: Standard track vs BNSF Neeley Leadership Program track, which only adds up to 15 of the 18 hours.

opportunities.text: Application; FINA 20203 requires TIP Board admission and a permission number.

opportunities.name: Educational Investment Fund
opportunities.text: FINA 30213 completed or in progress; two consecutive semesters (FINA 40183, FINA 40193); interview.

opportunities.name: Professional Program in Accounting (BBA + MAc in 5 years)
opportunities.text: 3.0 GPA; starts with ACCT 30101 seminar; GMAT waiver for the MAc.

opportunities.name: BNSF Neeley Leadership Program
opportunities.text: Selective cohort; its classes also count toward the Leadership minor.

opportunities.name: Study abroad / International field seminars
opportunities.text: Approved program coursework; WEM and some Core rules apply. Keep fall-only courses (such as FINA 40623) out of the semester you go abroad.
opportunities.planEffect: Keep fall-only courses (such as FINA 40623) out of the semester you go abroad.

cost.note: Tuition is half of TCU's $66,520 annual rate; housing and food are on-campus estimates. An extra semester also delays full-time pay. TCU gains the tuition, so the student's cost and the university's revenue are separate.

tuition.note: TCU 2026-27 undergraduate tuition: 1-8 hours $2,315/hr, 9-11 hours $2,825/hr, 12-18 hours $33,260 flat, over 18 hours $1,735/hr; Neeley differential $270 per credit hour of Neeley courses; summer $2,315/hr plus the Neeley differential. Later years will likely cost more.
